      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may incorrectly conclude that the discrepancy is resolved or that a specific source is authoritative when it is not.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: The WebSurfer repeatedly returns the same search result page without navigating to the specific links requested by the Planner.
